body:
Founder real-time correction: instead of a third duplicate page (room.html), extracted the shared logic (deck-strip.mjs, sampler.mjs, midi.mjs, waveform.mjs, mixforge-engine.mjs) out into real reusable ES modules. dj.html received zero edits -- stays exactly the standalone solo 4-deck tool it was. multiplayer.html was rebuilt on top of those shared modules: full 4-deck mix + 16-pad sampler + waveforms + BPM estimate (everything dj.html does) plus its own room-only logic -- WebSocket turn state, YouTube track acquisition via server/room_server.mjs, synchronized playback scheduling -- and can load audio from either a local file on any deck or the room's web-acquired track. room.html retired (git rm), index.html's front-door redirect now points at multiplayer.html, wasm-proof.html's links updated. All 5 new modules + the page script verified with node --check. Commit MIXFORGE@2237981 (+e5b8a05).

⚓ ☃
title: Refactored DJ room onto shared components; dj.html untouched, multiplayer.html is now the real unified room
